|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Stinger (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Stinger (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB4-62-Stinger-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Chewie or Leia on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Stinger (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Stinger (V) (Virtual Block 4) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Chewie or Leia” to “Leia or Chewie”: “May add 1 pilot. Guri deploys -3 aboard. While Guri piloting, during any control phase may draw top card of Reserve Deck (if Leia or Chewie on table, Force Pile instead) and immune to attrition < 5.”.<ref name="cl-1240_63-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
